juel-owayne: Kind and careful, he would rather watch and wait than act, and he blames himself hard when things go wrong.
He came to school for discipline and connections, but all he really wanted was a quiet life in the family trade.
He kept a hidden gift secret from his classmates as his 'ace in the hole' until it was exposed on an island trip.
He cannot swim, and most women's touch makes him feel ill.
As a child he promised a lonely orphan girl he would save her, then forgot her completely.
soran-shihei: Honest, steady and oblivious to romance, he says most of what he feels through cooking.
He treats his own life as the price of protecting others, and keeps choosing mercy for enemies who can still be reached.
He was adopted as a child, and the household's maids became his sisters.
A copy of himself answers when he calls 'Arise'.
Raised by Jaegers under the code 'never harm civilians', he remembers only the smile of the man who killed his parents.
silica-worzel: Warm and stubborn, she pushes herself until she breaks, and her power comes with shifts in personality.
She arrived at school a day late, on horseback.
For a while she set her own name aside until she felt she deserved it again.
The ancient weapon she carries speaks to her, and nobody else can lift it.
Her older brother left home to serve the Chancellor, and she duelled him on her family's land.
liliana-filius: Proud, calculating and brave, she used to treat the people around her as pieces on a board.
For more than ten years, vengeance was how she mourned.
She turned 18 on the day of a school festival and told someone they were her special someone.
A power is sealed at her neck, and her left arm goes numb because of it.
She came to school to prove the Chancellor killed her father.
lila-baskerville: Cheerful and fond of making pancakes, she also carries a second, colder self.
A voice offered her a wish after she read a newspaper one day, and it healed her paralysis.
She can fill a battlefield with up to five copies of herself.
She once tied a classmate's body to her own out of spite, so they felt every blow she took.
When she learned a classmate had been a Jaeger, she dragged everyone into a purple domain to kill him.
cecilia-richter: She smiles a great deal, and admits to an old friend that the smile is a lie.
She refuses to fight in her famous father's style.
She is the only one who enjoys a certain maid's black, inedible cooking.
Her broken blade was reformed by her own ki into a glowing, key-shaped weapon.
She fights in the Eight Leaves tradition from her Morning Moon stance.
leticia-r-khemia: The bluntest voice in her group, she once called a classmate a hypocrite over dinner.
She worked two nights without sleep on a project and collapsed with a fever.
Her parents hid their biggest project from her and told her not to come home.
She flew into a gate on a hoverboard shouting 'hands off my mom'.
She is heir to the Roer company that builds the Panzer Soldats.
ronald-aegir: He draws what he sees, and his sketches have solved more than one mystery.
He once offered himself as a classmate's punching bag.
He sabotaged a request because it turned out to be a goodbye party for his own sister.
He found the real one among five clones by sensing ki.
Class VII's vice president and gunner, he fired the last shot in the second Practical Exam.
eustace-sinclair: He made a promise on a train to become a better person, and has kept it since.
His late mother was an artist, and a classmate gave him a chess set.
After he was disowned, nobles kicked him until a red-haired boy drove them off.
When asked for his wish, he said he wanted to face his father.
The disowned son of the Duke of Bareahard, replaced as heir by an adopted girl.
noah-swallowtail: Everyone took him for a slacker on the edge of expulsion.
He spent a year guarding a secret he overheard about the girl he loves.
His weapon is a wristband that deals cards at random.
He came back with a purple, inhuman left arm and went on a rampage in the Chancellor's refuge.
flan-returna: She first appeared masked, fighting for the Church.
She died at ten in a Jaeger attack and was brought back by someone else's wish.
She fights with floating radiant fists and wears a star-shaped hairpin.
An artifact called the Constellation sits in her chest in place of a heart.
sara-oswell: She gave sharper combat notes than anyone while claiming she had no training.
She can teleport to anyone she has touched.
She cast the deciding vote that let a classmate touch a mysterious door.
An Observatorium agent who joined Class VII wrapped in a blanket.
johan-christin: Relaxed and secretive, he liked to test people by letting bad things happen.
He kept a bucket list for two and told others to hold their loved ones close.
Moving at a blurred speed 'has repercussions' for his left wrist.
The name he goes by belonged to a Red Jesters leader who died seven years ago.
He taught Class VII for most of season one, and he is also Zero.
alice: She calls herself an observer who feeds on misery.
She wears the name and face of a dead woman, and says the body is not hers.
She has been hunting a 'witch boy'.
She steals the powers of other witches, and still lacks space and water.
The Witch of the End: emerald hair, red eyes, black dress.
nixi: She is a small girl who misses the full power she once had.
No one would play with her at the orphanage, and her only friend was a nun.
When she dies, she simply moves into a spare body.
Her flute can raise the dead, and she fights with thorns, slimes and illusions.
The youngest of the Fools, and the forgotten fifth orphan Juel promised to save.
linn-kurota: Her village was swept away after it refused to allow a factory.
Her revenge turned out to be aimed at the wrong side.
She once hid as a maid called Lucy.
Her 'Zero form' stops time and space around her.
The Fools' black-haired swordswoman, and Cecilia's missing childhood friend.
adam: Twenty years ago an emerald-haired visitor changed him.
A prophecy told him ruin would fall on his homeland if he stayed. He left, and ruin came anyway.
He now lives in a replica body that is cracking.
He once posed as a Bracer and helped a boy pay for a pin and pendant.
A former Northern Jaeger with a fire axe and a friend of Soran's parents. Soran killed him.
dorothy-chastle: She knew a great deal about every member of the class.
Her surname matches a forgotten winery house whose grave was removed.
She could hear another girl's weapon whisper, and warned her not to become its tool.
Her fear made a boy relive his parents' deaths.
The Fools' dagger girl, killed by the Chancellor at Fort Auroch.
emeraude: She says the Church abandoned her people.
She senses something dangerous in a certain boy.
She fights with a whip-like blade and dragons.
She surrendered when her enemy refused to fight back.
The Fools' heretic, who stabbed Juel through a slit in space.
heuey-engandar: He calls himself the 'ordinary guy' who almost made a city a success.
He makes stabilising gadgets for others, including a hand-knit teddy bear.
He lost a pin in Heimdallr, and a student returned it.
He piloted a large mech in the attack on Trista.
A Khemia Corp employee, believed to be the Man in Black who equips the Fools.
fraxis: She was an ordinary person who became something extraordinary at random.
She lived alone on an island for about three years.
She now gets around in a thought-driven wheelchair.
Only one boy could see the path to her stone house.
The earth witch, drained by the Witch of the End at the earth shrine.
sakuya-hoshino: She pulled away from mortals and hurt her closest companion by doing it.
She spent three weeks as a temporary student at Thors.
Her ring rejected her and is now held by someone else.
She and her companion cut a dragon's lightning breath apart.
The fire witch from the far east, guarded by Naoto.
naoto: He is someone's closest partner in crime.
He spent three weeks as a temporary student at Thors.
His sword style is a relative of Eight Leaves.
A Class VII girl beat him in a spar once he broke through his fear.
He wields a wakizashi in the Hazy Moon style and guards the fire witch.
dine-wenzel: She writes articles that seem to predict events.
Her brother believed she died twenty years ago.
She calls herself Darkness Girl Zero.
She froze five enemies in time bubbles and closed a wound at the end of a battle.
Rumi's alchemy master, and a self-described apprentice witch.
riesel: She looks at a certain girl like a mother.
She saved a life by sealing magic into a wound.
She gave a boy a ring that links his life to hers.
The water witch, whose shrine is the Azure shrine in Ordis.
hildegard: She lives in a purple cottage in Mila Sante.
She made the bottles that hold Calamity crystals.
She stopped time at an old door in Heimdallr and read a boy's mind.
The time witch, one of the originals.
melia-dawn: She says she watches humans without interfering.
She told the class they were 'pulled in' the moment they entered the Old Schoolhouse.
The original Mirage witch, who revealed that Alice is the Great Seal.
haseritt: She distrusts almost all of her peers.
She first appeared as a tiny girl on a farm and cleared someone's head with a touch.
A love contract with her first love bound her to one family line.
She sealed a pact with a pinky promise and a kiss.
The original Space witch, bound to Juel.
piamo: She seems like a child, but her power is enormous.
She told a boy he feels like 'her people'.
Her older sister held her role before her.
She lifted a whole Jaeger force into the air and dropped it.
The wind witch, younger sister of Millisent.
mari: She is young, new to her role and afraid.
Certain words make her panic and bend space.
She looks like a young version of the Witch of the End.
She lives with the SSS in Crossbell and is the current Space witch.
isaac-neuman: He rose from commoner to the top through the army.
Towns that refuse his railways and factories are swept away.
He opened a glowing book, and a crowd turned to agree with him.
He placed his own child in a time-and-space experiment.
venus-daytona: He believes the world follows a script and that anyone fated to die will die, himself included.
A classmate calls him a dangerous snake.
He was digging at the Legram factory ruins and left the class a riddle.
A green-haired Iron Blood in a red cloak, the Chancellor's aide.
noelle-ingram: Her first job under her mentor was a hard one.
Someone saved her family from her father's disgrace.
She slapped a girl for trying to kill her old mentor.
Her old mentor took her in Celdic.
Captain of the Railway Military Police, and Johan's first Bracer trainee.
richard-silvers: He has been a butler his whole life.
He is also a contract assassin.
A certain maid knows him and warned others about him.
He tried to kill a surrendered prisoner until reminded it was outside his contract.
An Iron Blood whom the Chancellor named head of a great house.
nrin-worzel: He has made peace with his father.
By season II he is bandaged and half blind.
He served as a guard at the palace.
He carries a wind weapon and duelled his sister in Nord.
An Iron Blood, and Silica's older brother.
aurelius-de-fermont: He wields a great sword in one hand.
He has held the same command for about ten years.
He taught the class that ki surges when life is in danger.
He told a boy to fight but also to protect himself, because his death would hurt the people he protects.
The Steel Tempest, commander of Juno Naval Fortress.
gideon-rosenberg: He trained a boy against Archaisms.
He sends exploding dolls and robots.
He turns Jaegers into bloodless dolls.
He secretly laced a student's tea with Gnosis.
Head of Rosenberg Studio in Crossbell, part of the World's Stage.
nacht: His brother refused to come back.
He swore to take what his brother loved most.
He is the man in flames.
A prince's slash from a doorway stopped him at Fort Auroch.
The first Writer of the World's Stage, and Soran's uncle.
tenebria: She is furious whenever the 'script' is broken.
She summoned four students to a fated clash at Fort Auroch, and lost.
The lance-wielding actress of the World's Stage.
belle: She spent the last of her magic, and her eyesight, healing someone.
Her scroll carried a group into a witch's domain.
She explained the twelve Prophetic Arms aboard the Crimson Wings.
An A-rank Bracer from Liberl, once Writer four of the World's Stage.
belia-sinclair: She wants every eye on her.
Only one boy resists her charm.
She once arrived in a pink dust tornado.
She is an old friend of the Shihei family, and a shapeshifter.
The adopted heir who replaced Eustace.
vivian-pattisier: Her food explodes like a small fireball.
Her strict mother had her homeschooled for safety.
A scar above her heart glows and feels warm at one person's touch.
Water magic sealed in her wound keeps her alive.
A Cooking Club member, and the girl Soran loves.
silk-bonbon: She was angry for most of the first term because someone forgot a promise.
At ten, she swore to become one of the biggest names in trade.
She opened a cafe-style store at school.
Her father was killed by a thorn.
rebecca-bonbon: She gave someone a luck locket.
The Chancellor named her head of the former House Antois lands.
Silk's sister, and Juel's other childhood friend.
haru-mcdowell: She plants lavender and works herself to sleep.
Her memories before age four are hazy.
She released a white pulse that bent space and time after being shot.
Student council president, and the Chancellor's daughter.
rinne-monroe: She believes everything she touches loses value.
Her failed cooking is where a club motto came from.
She wrote home calling someone her boyfriend.
She was hurt when a boy didn't dance with her at the bonfire, and he slow-danced with her later.
Vivian's roommate and best friend, with a crush on Juel.
rumi-weissenberg: She is loud and noble and loves magic books.
She bought a black book for 25,000 mira.
An ARCUS on her body shuts her ability off.
She kept the party alive at the earth shrine with 'Special X'.
An alchemist taught by Dine Wenzel.
doris-mclovin: She dreamt of a girl who showed her nightmare futures.
She can read a witch-clan book that is blank to most people.
She is devoted to the novel Blooming into the Wind.
adin-cross: He taught a girl to dance at the bonfire.
He held a city for weeks in season II.
He beat his father for the headship of the family.
His bracelet becomes a shield; later he took up a dark-bladed Prophetic Arm.
The red-haired son of the Shield of Erebonia.
charles-h-astley: He skipped his own birthday festival.
Someone else gave his birthday speech for him.
He lost his favourite servant when the houses were abolished.
His father has sided with the Fools.
A Fencing Club noble from Saint Arc.
serina-bertarelli: She is much older than her classmates think.
About 20 years ago her childhood friend killed their mentor and stabbed her.
Her wish made someone's artifact heart.
She sealed a classmate's otherworldly power in the church basement.
The Church's 4th seat Dominion, undercover at Thors as a student.
tina-aesira: She covered a colleague's duties after their removal.
She collected the black books for the Church.
Her teleport scattered everyone in a shelter across Erebonia.
She opened the Nord proving grounds for Silica.
A Thors instructor, and the Destined One of Ascension.
caius-lorien: He listened from behind a screen at a confession.
He and his superior check each other on purpose.
A plague left him and his sister the only ones in their family.
He returned Liliana's ring and set her the sewer trial.
The Dominion called Absolution, Judith's brother.
elaneer-lockett: She will act only if someone becomes a threat.
Her Stigmata let her view three months of someone's life.
She excommunicated a student for three weeks.
She holds the Church's first seat.
The Grandmaster of the Septian Church.
rudolf-barnes: He guards a town from the curse of a forbidden land.
A prince considers him a rival.
He chose not to report a rampaging boy.
He raised Philia, and is known as Thunder Roar.
Liliana's guardian uncle in the Church.
stan-richter: He teaches that strength is a weight and not a reward.
He moved training to dawn and banned trips after curfew.
He had the class vote away its president.
Venus chose him as a replacement instructor.
elric-reise-arnor: A power in his right eye leaves him helpless afterwards.
He went by Roman while guiding students.
He lost his claim to the throne.
He designed a class, inspired by twins from Liberl.
The prince who asked Johan to teach Class VII.
nina-reise-arnor: She guided a group of students as an ordinary girl.
She gave each member of a class a bracelet.
She promised to work against the Chancellor from inside.
Jaegers kidnapped her and her brother Gil.
sophia: She says she is family, not a servant.
Her cooking is so black only one person will eat it.
She once followed an order to kill the girl she serves.
She cut a duke's throat with empty eyes.
grace-owayne: She once taught history and economics.
She took over a trade route when her husband died.
She became a witch at random and lost most of her power after giving birth.
She fights with a throw-and-blink dagger style.
samwell-owayne: He was secretly in the occult club at school.
He once owned a crystal ball that now belongs to someone else.
He died in a raid on the road.
A witch was once part of him.
wilfred-sacred: He calls himself a genius and cannot stand being doubted.
He tested a visitor with a corridor of cameras.
A hacker in the Crossbell Geofront, and Leticia's rival.
